display_name: US Equity Long-Term Value Batch Screening (Buffett Four Filters + DCF · v11)
description: Batch research for US equities. The cloud template runs a deterministic preflight, four research reviews, a three-statement + DCF model, a cloud evidence audit, a Markdown report and a 17-sheet workbook. Local work is data collection, explicit assumptions and optional independent verification. Research aid only; not investment advice.
